title: RCMN: Understanding Misleadingness in Influential Public Discourse
abstract: arXiv:2608.27358v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Influential public discourse shapes public beliefs and can also mislead, not only through what is stated, but also through how information is framed, omitted, contextualised, and communicated. Yet less research has focused on how such misleadingness arises and shapes the interpretations formed by readers. To address this gap, we introduce Reader-Centric Misleadingness Understanding (RCMN), a framework that operationalises misleadingness through five dimensions: misleading mechanism, likely reader interpretation, evidence-warranted interpretation, emotional arousal, and communicative intent. Based on this framework, we construct an evidence-grounded dataset of influential public discourse. translated_title: RCMN：理解有影响力的公共话语中的误导性
translated_abstract: 有影响力的公共话语塑造公众信念，也可能产生误导，不仅通过其陈述内容，还通过信息的框架、省略、情境化和传播方式。然而，较少研究关注这种误导性如何产生并影响读者形成的解读。为填补这一空白，我们引入了以读者为中心的误导性理解框架（RCMN），该框架通过五个维度来操作化误导性：误导机制、可能的读者解读、基于证据的解读、情绪唤起和交际意图。基于此框架，我们构建了一个基于证据的有影响力公共话语数据集。实证结果表明，误导性具有多样性，远不止于捏造，其中无根据的推断、夸大和省略是常见机制，并且常与情绪唤起增强和扭曲相关联。
tldr: 本文提出了一个以读者为中心的误导性理解框架（RCMN），通过五个维度系统分析有影响力公共话语中的误导性，并构建了基于证据的数据集，揭示了误导性远超捏造，涵盖推断、夸大和省略等多种机制。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a reader-centric framework (RCMN) to operationalize misleadingness in influential public discourse across five dimensions, and constructs an evidence-grounded dataset revealing that misleadingness extends beyond fabrication to include unsupported inference, exaggeration, and omission.
